steps.description:
Write a program that calls a function to perform the following: 1. Draw a circle with radius 120 pixels. Use "green" colour for the circle outline and fill the inside of the circle with "yellow" colour. Set the thickness of the circle outline to be 6 pixels.

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)
